metadata.title: Shredded Meat Pickle | Naga Style
metadata.description:
Meat pickles are quite popular in the state of Nagaland. Beef and pork pickles with king chili in them are literally a 'hot' favorite. Though this recipe is from Nagaland, They are quite a favorite among other Northeastern states as well. 

In this video I am showing you how to make shredded meat pickle, quick and easy.
